spans.s:
m. (-तुः)
1 A season, (the Hindu year is divided into ar seasons, each consisting of two months.)
2 The menstrual evacuation.
3 The time favourable for procreation, or sixteen days in each month.
4 A month.
5 A kind of collyrium.
6 Light.
E.
ऋ to go, तु Uṇādi aff.

m. (-लः)
1 The duration of a season.
2 The period menstruation.
3 The period favourable for procreation, sixteen days in each month.
E.
ऋतु and काल time.

m. (-णः)
The seasons collectively.
E.
ऋतु and गण class.

m. (-यः)
The revolution of the seasons.
E.
ऋतु an पर्य्याय revolution.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
Fruitful, fertile, &c. productive in due season^1.
E.
ऋतु season, and प्राप्त attained.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66. note: scan error.

f. (-तिः)
A woman during menstruation.
E.
ऋतु, मतुप् a.

m. (त्तिः)
A year.
E.
ऋतु a season, वृत्ति being.

m. (-जः)
Spring.
E.
ऋतु and राज king.

n. (-ङ्गं)
1 A sign of the season.
2 A symptom of menstruation.
E.
ऋतु and लिङ्ग a mark.

f. (-न्धिः)
The interval or junction between two seasons: the last seven days of one season and the first seven of the next.
E.
ऋतु and सन्धि union.

n. (-त्म्यं)
Diet, &c. suited to the season.
E.
ऋतु and सात्म्य suitableness.

f. (-ता)
A woman who has bathed after menstruation.
E.
ऋतु and स्नाता bathed.

n. (-नं)
Bathing after menstruation.
E.
ऋतु and स्नान bathing.
